spans.s:
रोचक, i. e. रुच् + अक,
 1. adj. What pleases, brightens.
 II. m.
 1.

. A stomachic.
 3. A sort of onion.
 4. Plantain.
 --Comp.

रोचन, i. e. रुच् + अन,
 I. adj.
 1.

. Sharpening (the appetite).
 II. m.
 1. A stomachic.
 2. The name of several plants.
 III. f. ना and नी, A yellow pigment, supposed to be the concrete bile of the cow, or to be found in the head of the animal,

.
 IV. f. ना, An excellent woman.
 V. f. नी, Red arsenic, Pāṇ. iv. 2, 2.
 VI. n. The æther,
रोचिष्णु, i. e. रुच् + इष्णु, adj. Elegantly dressed, Pāṇ. iii. 2, 136.

रोचिस्, i. e. रुच् + इस्, n. Light, flame.
 --Comp.
